title: Native VTE synthetic key-to-sampled-pixels baseline v1

frozen_cohort_manifest.p95_method: nearest rank,ceil(.95*n),no missing or failed observation excluded
frozen_cohort_manifest.calibration: One typed glyph and one cancelled blocked worker per fresh process; excluded, semantic screen text and pixel difference required
frozen_cohort_manifest.setup: Existing VTE0.84.0/Gtk3.24.52 and Xvfb software virtual display; child production UI controls with service-free fixture,40or1000history,1s cancellation cleanup
notes: Shared host; frozen source suite and development verification run concurrently
Synthetic key-command start includes process/X11/sampling overhead; physical monitor and AT not qualified
All six scenarios retained even if incomplete; no replacement or best-of

semantics.observation_status_PASS: The required semantic terminal text and calibrated native pixels were observed. This is not a latency-threshold result.
semantics.exit_code_0: Measurement completed and the app was joined; it does not require p95 criteria to pass. Supervisor final publication also follows joined Xvfb shutdown.
semantics.p95: Nearest-rank order statistic ceil(0.95*20)=19; strict p95 <100 ms input and <250 ms cancellation. No missing/failed observation excluded or replaced.
semantics.timing: monotonic_ns immediately before launching xdotool to first matching semantic text and native sampled pixels after GTK event processing; includes command launch, X11 delivery, processing and sampling overhead. Upper-bound observation, not an instrumented paint timestamp or physical input/display latency.
semantics.cancel: First visible Cancelling acknowledgement; joined_cleanup_ms is separate and includes the scripted 1-second worker cleanup delay.
semantics.sampling: One fresh app/VTE/Xvfb scenario per initial history/viewport; 20 sequential input observations followed by 20 sequential cancellation observations. Within-scenario observations are not independent fresh processes; submitted cancellation turns may grow the transcript.
semantics.history: 40-message fixture includes Unicode and long paths; 1000-message fixture uses numbered readable-text messages. These are distinct scripted initial workloads, not a controlled history-length-only causal comparison.
semantics.host_memory: 129111432 KiB from frozen manifest, approximately 123.13025665283203 GiB host RAM; no application memory or 16 GiB device qualification.

environment_limits: Shared Linux Xeon Gold 6132 host, 56 logical CPUs, no CPU affinity/load isolation; concurrent verification was recorded.
Native VTE 0.84.0 / GTK 3.24.52; Xvfb software virtual display, Monospace 12, 10x19 pixels per cell.
LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 and GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe; Xvfb logs retain permission-denied /dev/dri warnings, not GPU qualification.
No physical monitor/input-device, Windows/macOS, AT/screen-reader, remote terminal, IME or clipboard qualification.
No model/provider/network performance, local-model usefulness, or 16 GiB memory qualification.
Only 20 samples per action/case; descriptive baseline, no confidence interval or causal optimization claim.
Historical harness copies retain host-specific paths and pre-existing style findings; repointing creates new harness hashes.
next_gap: Attribute long-history acknowledgement delay across app rendering, terminal processing and measurement overhead, then evaluate a separately frozen candidate with the same retained protocol; this baseline alone does not establish the cause or qualify an issue/release.
